native_mechanism_note: SEMANTIC MISMATCH: recipe is single-clip terminal fade (outro, no clip_b); fadeblack between two clips approximates a terminal effect.
description: Final clip fades to full black over 1.0s with audio fading in parallel. Canonical outro / cliffhanger close. Reads as 'end of chapter' — sets up next-video tease.

ffmpeg_params.fade_start: Set = duration(clip_a) - 1.0. Last second of the clip fades simultaneously video + audio.

audio_recipe: afade=t=out:d=1.0 in parallel with video fade. Music/ambient bed must also taper — if scheduled separately in HyperFrames, add explicit afade out on those tracks too.
use_cases: Final outro of reel before cliffhanger card
End of horror-choice video: 'Una noche en paz' card setup
Transition into static outro card / CTA
avoid_for: Reels <60s where airtime is precious — 1.0s of fade is 1.7% of total
Energetic format outros (use light-flash-impact + cut to card)
hyperframes_alternative: GSAP: tl.to('.final-scene', {opacity:0, duration:1.0}, 'tOutro').to('#audio-bed', {volume:0, duration:1.0}, 'tOutro'). Black background body color provides the destination.
canonical_observations: Observed in ref-03 at 49.2-49.7s ('Explosion visual + fade negro' post-death of consequence A2) — used as longer death-cut close, but functionally serves as scene-end fade. Observed in ref-12 at 111.0-113.0s explicit 'Fade out (probable). Music crescendo final' — canonical outro before video end. NOT observed as outro in ref-06/08/09/10/11/13 — these end with hard cut to counterfactual cozy scene (no fade-to-black bridge). Pattern in F1: hard cut to counterfactual is more common (6/8) than fade-to-black outro (2/8). Prior citation of ref-01/04/07 invalid — those refs not in F1 set.
validated_notes: 2/8 explicit F1 outros use fade-to-black 1.0s. More common F1 pattern (6/8) is hard cut directly to counterfactual cozy scene without fade. Use this transition when narrative explicitly requires 'end of chapter' weight, not as default outro.
